name: Ollama
description: 极简命令行与后台服务，本地一键下载并运行 DeepSeek、Llama 3、Qwen 等开源顶尖大模型，零门槛白嫖本地算力。
descriptionEn: Get up and running with large language models locally. One-command download and run DeepSeek, Llama 3, and Qwen on your own hardware.
warningText: 纯开源无套路。需根据本机显存/内存大小合理选择量化版本（如 8B 建议 16G 内存，70B 需多卡或高配）。
warningTextEn: Fully open-source with local REST API. Pick appropriate GGUF quantizations (8B models comfortably run on 16GB RAM/VRAM; 70B requires hefty unified memory).

name: LM Studio
description: 颜值极高的桌面本地模型工作台，内置 HuggingFace 模型检索、一键下载、图形化硬件加速配置与本地 API Server。
descriptionEn: Sleek desktop GUI to discover, download, and run GGUF models directly from Hugging Face with native hardware acceleration (Apple Silicon / CUDA).
warningText: 个人完全免费。初次下载大模型时建议配置代理或镜像站以加速下载。
warningTextEn: Free for personal use. Built-in local server is drop-in compatible with OpenAI API specifications.

name: ComfyUI
description: 目前最强、显存利用率最高的节点式开源 AI 绘图工作流，支持 FLUX.1、SDXL、ControlNet、AnimateDiff 等一切前沿模型。
descriptionEn: The most powerful and modular node-based GUI and backend for Stable Diffusion, FLUX.1, SDXL, and video generation with optimal VRAM caching.
warningText: 完全开源免费。注意：第三方整合包往往暗藏挖矿或诱导付费，强烈建议从官方 GitHub 或官方桌面客户端安装。
warningTextEn: Completely free open-source. Beware of shady third-party repackaged zips; always clone or install from official GitHub or desktop client.

name: Cherry Studio
description: 为专业极客打造的多模型聚合桌面客户端，支持 30+ 厂商 API 及本地 Ollama、LM Studio，无缝管理知识库与 Prompt。
descriptionEn: Polished open-source multi-model desktop client. Seamlessly aggregate OpenAI, Claude, DeepSeek, and local Ollama with RAG and prompt libraries.
warningText: 完全开源免费无广告。自身不带免费大模型 API Key，需接入自购 Key 或本地 Ollama 免费模型。
warningTextEn: Clean open-source with zero built-in ads. Bring your own API keys or link directly to your local Ollama/LM Studio instance for 100% free usage.

name: LibreChat
description: 功能最完善的开源自托管 AI 对话前端，完美复刻 ChatGPT Plus/Team 界面，支持代码执行、图像生成、多用户鉴权与插件系统。
descriptionEn: The ultimate open-source ChatGPT alternative. Self-hostable web UI with multi-user auth, Claude/OpenAI/Ollama backends, code artifacts, and plugins.
warningText: 纯开源无广告。支持 Docker 一键自建，杜绝第三方套壳站数据泄露风险。
warningTextEn: No telemetry or vendor lock-in. Deploys via Docker Compose in minutes for teams or personal privacy.

name: SillyTavern (酒馆)
description: 终极本地 AI 角色扮演与复杂提示词交互前端，拥有最庞大的社区角色卡生态与高级上下文记忆插件。
descriptionEn: Advanced user interface for LLMs and creative writing. Features deep character card management, lorebooks, and customizable prompt architectures.
warningText: 工具本身完全开源安全。注意：社区部分第三方角色卡或扩展插件来源混杂，请勿运行未经审计的执行脚本。
warningTextEn: The core repo is secure and audited. Be cautious with unverified third-party user scripts and community character card macros.

name: whisper.cpp
description: 高性能轻量级 C/C++ 实现的 OpenAI Whisper 离线语音识别转写引擎，可在普通 CPU 或轻薄本上极速离线听写音频。
descriptionEn: High-performance inference of OpenAI's Whisper model in pure C/C++. Run blazing-fast offline speech-to-text without cloud telemetry.
warningText: 完全开源无内购。离线运行保护隐私，无需担心会议或私密录音上传云端泄密。
warningTextEn: Pure offline binary with zero network outbound calls. Ideal for transcribing sensitive meetings or confidential audio recordings.

name: Hugging Face
description: 全球最大的开源 AI 模型、数据集与演示应用开源社区，AI 时代的 GitHub，无数顶尖权重与 Spaces 在线免费白嫖玩耍。
descriptionEn: The GitHub of Machine Learning. Access hundreds of thousands of open-source models, datasets, and free community Spaces demos.
warningText: 官方平台。免费账户即可体验社区大量 Spaces 免费托管的生图与对话模型。
warningTextEn: A free community account grants access to explore community weights and host lightweight Spaces without charge.
